manual_review.bledy_faktograficzne: ubiquitous at every checkpoint: 10k invents dates/institutions (1863, Polski Zwiazek Pisarzy, BBC programmes, Davis Cup ending an experiment); 12.5k invents entities (Marek Kobenski, Kinformator) plus date-list spam; 15k generic waffle still wrong (ML = silniki elektryczne, 1966 experiment); 44k pseudo-census numbers (89.1%, droga 666, 119.6 km). No checkpoint is factually usable.
manual_review.naturalne_zakonczenia: EOS/terminal-punctuation rate low everywhere (panel max 80 tok binds ~34/40 outputs); ranking 44k 12/40 > 15k 10/40 > 10k 6/40 > 12.5k 5/40. EOS counts: 15k 7, 10k 6, 12.5k 4.
manual_review.petle: 12.5k collapsed into loops (24/40: 'nie jest to mozliwe', date lists, Iberyjskiego, vice-chair, ton/s); 44k loops often (20/40: energia potencjalna, parish, maszyn, poznalem); 10k/15k moderate (13/40 each, mostly conservative preset).
manual_review.pseudo_encyklopedia_web_residue: 0/40 hits at every checkpoint on both runs; caveat: 44k produced census-like template text the regex set did not flag, so 0 is pattern-coverage, not proof of absence.
manual_review.skladnia: orthography clean everywhere (odd_word_ratio 0.0, no pseudo/web hits); avg dominant_word_share 10k 0.1445 / 12.5k 0.1800 / 15k 0.1419 confirms the 12.5k loop peak.
manual_review.trzymanie_tematu: weak base-LM level at all checkpoints; 44k opens on-topic more often (city/census frames) then drifts; v242 drifts into literary/dialogue or date spam. No checkpoint holds topic reliably; not a differentiator.
manual_review.uciecia: cutoff_like 33-36/40 (v242) and 30/40 (44k): the 80-token cap binds nearly everything, consistent with low natural-ending rates.
